scope: Read-only findings for the separate Settings > Plugins surface and its boundary with Space Assistant connections.

findings.finding: Settings > Plugins has its own installed-plugin inventory, enabled-plugin settings, and separate Gmail/Discord visibility toggles. The inventory shows name, key/id, version, description, lifecycle hooks, and enabled/disabled state.
findings.interpretation: This inventory is not a model-provider catalog or proof of a usable API connection. Keep it distinct from Space Assistant capability evidence.

findings.finding: The Settings > Plugins renderer handled null, valid, and malformed fixtures without an ErrorBoundary failure or the targeted undefined-to-object TypeError; malformed extensions displayed a local error.

A restricted taskless plugin with a validated start URL is exposed in Space Assistant as browser-only access, never as an API connection. The scoped App callback revalidates current catalog/scope before opening a tab.
findings.limits: The root source-App probe is reported separately in docs/root-space-assistant-simple-ux.md; this JSON records renderer/settings evidence, not provider access or packaged-app behavior.
